test_title: PYST 47: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Pollution levels have increased so __largely __that they are almost killing us.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"largely"** means to a great extent; on the whole; mostly. (मुख्य रूप से)

 
 
• **Example: **The success of the project was largely due to the hard work of the team.
 
 
 
• **"Highly"** refers to something done to a great degree or extremely. (बहुत अधिक)
 
 
• **Example: **The movie was highly praised by critics.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the context of the sentence, "highly" is a more appropriate word to convey the extent of the increase in pollution levels.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1., highly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Slowly** (धीरे-धीरे): At a slow speed; not quickly.

 
 
• **Example:** The car moved slowly through the traffic.
 
 
 
• **Primarily** (मुख्य रूप से): For the most part; mainly.
 
 
• **Example: **He is primarily responsible for the company's success.
 
 
 
• **Chiefly** (मुख्यतः): Mainly; for the most part.
 
 
• **Example:** The problem lies chiefly in the way the data was collected.
